w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Yasmina is calling it "Old Gavel." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Buffering is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
That night, they bring Andre home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/7/5), with 2 wave-4 fought, 14 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Mia Andersson ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
